name: Izumi Toshihiko
source: A second-year at Konoehara. He was part of the student council and the brass band. He seemed like a decent kid, but he [spoiler]bullied Hanako to the point of suicide after losing a contest. He was killed by Hanako, and his death was treated as a disappearance[/spoiler].
